item.text: {"search_note":"Mildly supportive, with gaps. Scholz in 2024 did not try to bypass institutions that constrained him, and there is some direct evidence of strengthening institutional capacity: judicial digitization, transparent executive-trace tools, and local-government debt relief. The main negative is structural: Germany’s surveillance framework still had constitutional defects in 2024. I did not find strong 2024 evidence that he substantially reformed courts or audit bodies. The strongest counterevidence is the BVerfG surveillance ruling, which shows an important oversight deficit remained unresolved.","evidence":[{"title":"Regierungserklärung von Bundeskanzler Olaf Scholz","publisher":"Bundesregierung","date":"2024-11-13","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/suche/regierungserklaerung-von-bundeskanzler-olaf-scholz-2320314","summary":"Scholz said he would request a confidence vote and described an orderly democratic process in which citizens would decide the country’s direction.
